titre: Le marché américain de la technologie grand public en 2026
sous_titre: Croissance attendue sur un an, en pourcentage

Volumes expédiés.texte: unit shipments are forecast to grow just 0.7% in 2026

Matériel.texte: Hardware revenues are expected to grow 3.4%

Ensemble du marché.texte: the industry is projected to reach $565 billion in revenue in 2026, growing 3.7% year over year

Logiciels et services.texte: consumer spending on software and services is projected to rise 4.2%, reaching nearly $194 billion
